items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and monetization expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing disclosures, consent, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. SearchWoot must remain private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access but not redistribution, storage, derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; public terms restrict commercial/public product-data use. Legal data-use review remains incomplete for all four items. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates are blocked. Fleet compliance is only 35 pass of 61, with 20 fail and 6 unknown; analytics is unavailable across the fleet and revenue supports only $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21. Exact decision: do not launch, monetize, expand notifications, or send rights outreach. Continue bounded read-only evidence work and existing reversible work only. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, privacy/jurisdictional treatment, and any affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. No task is closed because required evidence is not complete. Source-rights task: blocked pending current API agreement or written permission and field-level terms. Data-flow task: partial repository evidence exists, but operator-confirmed retention, deletion, correction, access, and notification records are missing. GA4 task: privacy and cookie pages exist, but deployed consent behavior, GA4 settings, retention, data-sharing, and jurisdiction review are missing. Logs/vendors task: no complete log-field, retention/access, vendor/DPA, incident, or request-procedure evidence is recorded. Next evidence action: produce one dated read-only evidence bundle containing the source-rights matrix, alert-data-flow/retention table, consent/configuration capture, and logs/vendor/incident inventory; route rights and jurisdictional issues to human counsel before any outreach or launch decision.
